verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents a REST API, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, SDKs and a launcher for coding agents. None of these is an MCP server, and the 'Apps' connection for Claude/ChatGPT Desktop is never described as MCP, so this counts as absence of evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
